flags: The archived FDOT page begins its general directions with a Destin/W 30A approach outside Big Bend. Omitted that apparent copy-and-paste error and used the subsequent detailed Big Bend corridor description.

The cache supports the state-program designation of November 14, 2006 and FHWA’s National Scenic Byway status, but not the catalog’s 2009 national-designation date. Omitted the national year. Original road-building and byway-campaign history remain thin.

The old Sopchoppy text conflates the Carrabelle, Tallahassee & Georgia Railroad with the Georgia, Florida and Alabama successor and its Gopher, Frog & Alligator nickname, as does the cached article. Retained documented cargo and depot history, omitting the nickname and succession claim.
The official archived profile gives 30 carnivorous plants, without the old draft’s “about.” Omitted the count and world-comparison claim because no supporting botanical source is saved.

The strip map contains multiple branches with restarting mileages. The chosen sequence is Newport/St. Marks lighthouse excursion, forest loop to Sopchoppy, then coastal US 98 west to Carrabelle and Apalachicola. This is not a single continuous 220-mile through-road.
